aboutDescription: A desktop app for tracking results of the Traditional Bow Cup (PTL), Scandinavian scoring method. Register archers, track scores across bow categories and age groups, and export results.
aboutStep1Desc: Click <btn>New competition</btn> and fill in the name, date, and location. Optionally upload an organizer logo.
aboutStep2Desc: Click <btn>Add Archers</btn> to register participants. Upload a CSV file, or add archers one by one manually.
aboutStep3Desc: Click <btn>Add Score</btn>, select an archer, and enter scores for 10 possible results. The total must be exactly 28 hits.
aboutStep4Desc: Archers are automatically ranked within their bow category, age group, and gender. Use filters to narrow the view.
aboutStep5Desc: Click <btn>Print Results</btn> to generate and save a formatted Excel report with the full competition rankings, based on the currently active table filters. If no filter is selected, all categories are exported together.
